meta.name: pr-threshold
meta.description: Track commit accumulation and trigger PR when thresholds crossed

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动监测提交量并创建拉取请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望自动管理PR创建时机
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create pull requests when commit thresholds are crossed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automate PR creation based on commit accumulation

howto.what: 安装后，当代码行数、修改文件数或提交次数超过设定阈值时，Claude 会自动提醒你推送 Pull Request（PR）进行人工审查，避免 PR 变得太大或太复杂。
howto.when: 每次成功执行 git 提交后自动触发，或者在代理模式（Agent Mode）的提交工作流中触发。你也可以手动输入“use pr-threshold skill”来激活。

say.text: 检查当前累积的提交指标，看是否需要推送 PR。
say.note: Claude 会显示各指标是否超过阈值，并给出建议。

say.text: 强制推送 PR 并暂停工作。
say.note: 仅当阈值被超越且你想手动决定时使用。

say.text: 告诉我当前的代码行数和文件修改数。
say.note: Claude 会报告累积数值与阈值对比。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude monitors lines of code, files changed, and commit count after each git commit. When any metric exceeds predefined thresholds (e.g., >300 LOC, >10 files, >5 commits), it suggests or enforces pushing a PR for human review to prevent overly large changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered automatically after each successful git commit, or during Agent Mode commit-level workflows. Can also be invoked manually by saying "use pr-threshold skill".

say_en.text: Check current accumulated metrics and see if a PR is needed.
say_en.note: Claude shows metric values vs thresholds and recommends action.

say_en.text: Force trigger a PR and pause further commits.
say_en.note: Use when threshold is crossed but you want to decide.

say_en.text: Tell me the current LOC and file change count.
say_en.note: Claude reports the running totals compared to limits.
